notes:
BUILD 58
- Smoother: the wide shadow map is redrawn every third frame instead of every frame, unlit light slots cost nothing, and full-detail trees stop at 165 m instead of 215 m (the far ones are the cheap kind). Roughly a third fewer triangles and far fewer shadow draws at the Outpost and in forest.
- Scientists and survivors need something under their feet: no more walking on air off the oil rig or across the sea, and bodies fall instead of hanging in the sky. One that walks off an edge falls, and dies if it is a long drop or into the sea.
- Headshots: a round through the head of a scientist or survivor does double damage.
- The Outpost can be raided. Its sentry turrets can now be destroyed (1800 health each; shooting one locks them all on to you), and there are two locked crates and a military crate in the back corner. Starting on a locked crate there ends the peace.
- Water: a splash when you go in, spray with each swimming stroke and when wading, a tint when your eyes are under the surface. You float a little higher, so looking down no longer cuts the view at the waterline. The jump out of water is lower (it was sending you three metres up).
- Oil rig: steps lead down into the sea from the landing stage so you can climb out of the water.
- Big containers and bodies with a lot on them shrink their slots to fit the screen.
- A better workbench than a recipe needs speeds it up: 30% faster one level up, 50% two levels up, 60% three.
- Survivor traders have five of each trade and restock every ten minutes.
- Being wet is much colder, and wet clothes insulate far less.
- Rope, sewing kits and sheet metal are listed under Resources in the crafting menu.
